headings: Schema is TOML rather than YAML so validation can stay inside the
workspace `toml` crate that `xtask` already depends on, with no new
Required fields per task: id, title, mode, readiness_row, files,
Required fields per feature: id, title. (tasks may be empty.)
Required fields per epic: id, title, milestone, readiness_rows.
Validation is performed by `cargo run -p xtask -- verify-kanban-backlog`
which checks unique ids, required fields, and that every dependency
resolves to an epic, feature, or task in the same file.
Optional per-task fields: `status` (todo | in-progress | done | blocked;
defaults to todo) and `evidence` (path to the evidence file/command output
backing the status). A task marked `status = "done"` MUST carry a
non-empty `evidence` value; the validator rejects done-without-evidence.
Epic mapping to v0.2 milestones: P0→M7, P1-P2→M8, P3-P4→M9, P5→M10, P6→M11, P7-P8→M12, P9→M13

Proposal auto-approval policy — graduated approval ladder
The graduated approval ladder has four levels:
Auto             — all deterministic rules allow AND every rule ID cited in
the assessment is listed in `allowed_rule_ids`.  The
proposal is applied without a human approval step.
Ask              — all rules allow but `enabled = false` or a rule ID is not
in `allowed_rule_ids`.  Surface to the human for a quick
RequireExplicit  — one or more non-critical rules denied the change (e.g.
file count exceeded, lockfile touched).  The proposal is
paused until the human explicitly approves.
Deny             — a critical path-scope violation was detected (a touched
path escapes the approved workspace root).  The proposal
Default (everything off): `enabled = false` → every proposal is Ask or higher.
